sam: hi team — first day! quick map request: who owns the routing for API endpoints, who handles model onboarding approvals, and who signs off on sandbox infra bookings? trying to make a week1 plan without pinging everyone.
claire (people-ops): welcome sam! :tada: short map: API routing/OWNERS -> eng-platform (ping @toni), model onboarding -> eng-ml (ping @hera), sandbox infra/hardware bookings -> eng-infra via #eng-infra-bookings or open a ticket (include gpu type + dates). i'll DM a condensed contact card.
toni (eng-platform): for API routing owners check service OWNERS in the repo (root/OWNERS or services/*/OWNERS). if you list the service name i can point to the owner. we also keep a routing-map doc: https://internal/docs/routing-map. for deploy windows ping #release-war-room or use `deploy-bot status <service>`.
hera (eng-ml): model onboard: open a model-onboard issue with sample prompts, eval plan, and privacy notes. we triage in 48h. if it's a reproducibility perf run, include expected qps and seq_len so we can pre-assign a test slot.
raph (eng-sre): oncall shadowing: we pair new hires 1 day with primary then 1 day with secondary. for SLO/escalation triage, see the runbook pinned in #incidents. emergency paging: page primary -> secondary -> eng-sre rotation -> @raph.
sam: thanks — can someone paste the minimal access request format? also who approves dashboard read access?
access-bot: Access requests processed via #access-requests. Minimal template: `Subject, Resources, Access needed, Justification, Duration, Approver`. Dashboards: request ops-read via #access-requests; approver usually the dashboard owner listed in the dashboard metadata.
claire (people-ops): i'll schedule a compact week1: Mon AM: repo/OWNERS + API routing with @toni, Mon PM: access requests + infra creds, Tue: model-onboard walkthrough with @hera, Wed: perf booking + infra pairing, Thu: SRE shadow with @raph, Fri: sync + open Q&A. prefer calendar invites?
sam: calendar invites please, with docs links. i'll draft the access request and tag folks. thanks all!
